feedback_driven.quote: Post-task self-improvement revises skills, prompts, and workflows after each batch, adopting candidates only when they generate harder valid tasks within a bounded cost increase.

persists_across_tasks.quote: Online self-improvement converts intermediate solver failures into reusable skills during generation.
